::: {#exr-table-trace}
#### Reading a DFA from a table

A DFA has states $p_0$, $p_1$, $p_2$ and $p_3$, inputs $\mathtt{0}$ and $\mathtt{1}$, initial state $p_0$ and one accepting state, $p_3$.
Its transitions are given by this table, in which the entry in the row of a state and the column of an input
is the state that the input leads to:

| state | $\mathtt{0}$ | $\mathtt{1}$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| $p_0$ | $p_0$ | $p_1$ |
| $p_1$ | $p_0$ | $p_2$ |
| $p_2$ | $p_3$ | $p_2$ |
| $p_3$ | $p_3$ | $p_3$ |

Does this DFA accept the string $\mathtt{0101100}$?

:::
